A sybil cluster whose copper and walnut identities are densely linked internally but sparsely linked outward has low conductance: few edges cross its boundary relative to its volume. Under the anchor and cap assumptions, min-cut and transitivity bounds limit trust entering the cluster, thereby bounding its aggregate voting weight.
